If that fails, propose to w, where I have the highest priority. y will be my last choice due to its competitiveness and lower preference.

2. **Common Preferences:**
   - Most applicants favor y > x > w > z, similar to my own preferences.

3. **Strategy:**

   - Lastly, if all else fails, I will propose to z, where I also have the highest priority (1).

Therefore, I will submit my ranking truthfully as y > x > w > z, maximizing my chances of being matched with one of my top choices.
